pkgmetadata.longdescription: Parses DMARC aggregate (rua) and failure (ruf) reports and SMTP TLS (RFC 8460) reports, from files, IMAP, Maildir or mbox, and writes JSON/CSV or sends them to Splunk, syslog, a webhook, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch or S3. The Elasticsearch (before 9), Kafka, GELF, Azure Log Analytics, Gmail and Microsoft Graph integrations are not packaged.
